packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: always pin to a full SHA, keep a comment with the full version (e.g. # v6.4.0), and wait 7 days after a release before opening a PR. internalChecksFilter=strict suppresses the update (visible on the Dependency Dashboard) until the 7 days elapse, so no PR is created up front.
npm: group dev tooling so bumps land as one PR; dist is rebuilt in the PR by CI failing until npm run package is committed.
